newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish sharply higher.

text.p: IMM currency futures finished sharply higher in brisk trading, fueled by the Fed leaving short-term interest rates unchanged.
Traders said the dollar had already factored in a 25-basis-point rate hike, sending currency futures higher when a rate rise didn't materialize after Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
"Long term, we're looking for a higher dollar, but today we saw a correction to the uptrend," a currency analyst said.
Some key IMM currency contracts rallied to more than two-week highs, with trading brisk late, traders said.
